payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into what the model learns in a zero-shot setting, particularly in the context of cross-lingual transfer learning and reading comprehension tasks.

claims.text: In a zero-shot setting, the model learns language-independent strategies that allow it to apply knowledge from one language to another without needing translation.
The model demonstrates the ability to transfer knowledge between languages with low lexical similarity, indicating it learns to generalize across different languages.
Pre-trained multilingual models like multi-BERT can effectively perform reading comprehension tasks in a zero-shot manner, leveraging their training on multilingual corpora.
